title: Production Market-Data Ingestion Package (133 Launch Candidates)
description: Non-executable specification for historical backfill and incremental freshness update for 133 Radar launch candidates with explicit multi-tier sizing alternatives without executing production writes.

governance_status.blocking_rationale: Live bounded requests on production container revealed: Polygon API key returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized (Unknown API Key); Alpaca feed=sip returns HTTP 403 Forbidden (Free tier lacks SIP entitlement); Alpaca feed=iex is participant-only volume. Production ingestion is blocked pending provisioning of valid consolidated market data credentials.

acquisition_window_strategy.explanation: A calendar date window (e.g. 400 calendar days) is a request strategy, not a mathematical guarantee of returned bars. Actual returned rows depend on provider trading session calendar, exchange holidays, security IPO/listing date, and trading halts.
acquisition_window_strategy.unseasoned_security_handling: Securities with insufficient listing history will not be forced to 260 rows. Actual returned rows will be recorded, and consumer readiness evaluated according to actual returned count (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_LISTING_HISTORY for strategy benchmark).
acquisition_window_strategy.missing_session_handling: Provider omissions or missing sessions do not halt pipeline but trigger partial-response review flag.

downstream_strategy_benchmark.consumer: VCPClassifier / Conformance Oracle (52-week lookback, 200 DMA, Minervini trend template)

illustrative_calendar_year_estimate.consumer: Illustrative sizing calculation (US trading sessions in 1 calendar year)

production_missing_candidates.rationale: Launch candidates confirmed missing from production store during readback; requires historical backfill.

production_stale_candidates.rationale: Launch candidates present in production store but with max trade date prior to 2026-10-19; requires incremental freshness update.

local_developer_store_gap.explanation: Local dev store lacks production synchronization. GOOG is present in production with 287 bars (ending 2026-10-16) but absent locally. JNJ is present in production with 251 bars but absent locally.

alternative_a_builder_minimum_60_bars.purpose: Minimum history required to satisfy UniverseBuilder evaluate_security_data_readiness() data readiness gate.

alternative_b_strategy_benchmark_260_bar.purpose: Benchmark history required for downstream 52-week lookback, 200-day moving average, and VCP trend template.
alternative_b_strategy_benchmark_260_bar.reconciliation_rationale: 1 calendar year (~251-252 trading sessions) is mathematically insufficient to guarantee 260 bars. The calendar window starts on 2025-09-15 (400 calendar days) yielding ~275 trading sessions to safely request >= 260 bars.

alternative_c_illustrative_calendar_sess.purpose: Estimated trading sessions for 1 standard US calendar year (illustrative estimate, not an approved consumer contract).

polygon.rate_limit_documented: 5 API requests per minute (Free tier basic)
polygon.historical_lookback_documented: 2 years historical data on basic tier
polygon.entitlement_tier: Configured 23-char key is invalid/unauthorized on Polygon endpoints
polygon.adjustment_semantics: Split-adjusted daily OHLCV bars (dividends unadjusted per canonical contract)
polygon.feed_scope: Consolidated US equity market volume (SIP aggregated)
polygon.feed_comparability_notes: Consolidated SIP volume is standard for liquidity/turnover floor checks (Rule L04).

alpaca.historical_lookback_documented: 5 years historical data on basic IEX feed
alpaca.entitlement_tier: Free / Basic tier (querying feed=sip returns HTTP 403 Forbidden)
alpaca.adjustment_semantics: Split-adjusted daily OHLCV bars via IEX feed (dividends unadjusted per canonical contract)
alpaca.feed_comparability_notes: IEX volume represents a minority fraction (~2-4%) of consolidated US equity turnover. Direct dollar volume calculations using IEX volume underestimate true market liquidity and cannot be substituted for consolidated market volume.

production_target_backfill.benchmark_window_260: 2025-09-15 to 2026-10-19 (400 calendar days / ~275 trading sessions request window strategy)
production_target_backfill.builder_window_60: 2026-07-16 to 2026-10-19 (95 calendar days / ~65 trading sessions request window strategy)
production_target_backfill.illustrative_window_251: 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-19 (~1 calendar year / ~251 trading sessions estimate)
production_target_backfill.variable_row_count_notice: Actual returned row count depends on provider session calendar, IPO date, and listing history; 251 rows is an estimate, not a guaranteed fixed constant.

production_target_refresh.window: Day after observed max_date to 2026-10-19 (exact per-symbol windows)

local_developer_store_gap.goog_note: GOOG has 287 bars present in production store (latest_trade_date: 2026-10-16) but is absent in local dev store. Local absence must NOT generate a production backfill request.

ingestion_scope.adjustment_policy: SPLIT_ADJUSTED_ONLY (Zero dividend adjustments per canonical contract)
ingestion_scope.entitlement_tier: Consolidated market data access is unverified/blocked across configured keys

bar_validation_specification.finite_numeric_values: open > 0, high > 0, low > 0, close > 0, all values finite, non-null, non-NaN, non-infinite
bar_validation_specification.valid_dates_and_identity: trade_date matches ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD within requested window, symbol uppercase matching association
bar_validation_specification.ohlc_consistency: high >= low, high >= open, high >= close, low <= open, low <= close
bar_validation_specification.duplicate_handling: UNIQUE(symbol, trade_date) primary key enforcement; duplicate bars rejected
bar_validation_specification.failure_and_partial_response_handling: HTTP non-200, truncated payloads, or row validation failures trigger atomic rollback and fail closed

atomic_guarantees.anomaly_rejection: Full bar_validation_specification enforced prior to insertion
